items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: And I made him play with a hat over the bell of his horn or with the horn in mute

ctx.x: Par Jones used to put that harmon mute in there, and the Oasis was an intimate place, and I just used tenor, trumpet, piano, drums and bass. And I made him play with a hat over the bell of his horn or with the horn in mute, you know, and I used brushes all the time, and the people just -- you know, you had to play for people to dance, and the people had to talk, and they could hear themselves. And we stayed there quite some time, you know?
